headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned, bitcoin slipped to about $71,000 alongside tech stocks, and markets still price a December Fed rate hike as near-certain.

market.asOf: Read about 15:54-15:58 UTC Thu 12 Nov (22:54 Bangkok; 10:54am ET). BTC: CoinGecko $71,479.65 (-2.80% in 24h). ETH: CoinGecko $2,001.51 (-2.70%). SOL: CoinLore $81.41 (-4.04%). Prices were moving fast; use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: 29, Fear (alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index); 32 yesterday, 34 a week ago and 69 (Greed) a month ago.

stories.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns; CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO
stories.summary: Nvidia said Jensen Huang has resigned as president, CEO and board member, effective immediately, and CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent one. Bitcoin fell with tech shares after the news. Nvidia's own statement gives no reason.
points: Kress stays on as CFO; former Synopsys CEO Harvey C. Jones becomes Nvidia's board chair, per Nvidia.
Q3 results remain on Tue 17 November, as previously scheduled, per Nvidia.
Nvidia shares fell as much as 13% early and were about 5% lower around 10:51am ET, per Yahoo Finance; CoinDesk had them about 7% lower at 10:00am ET.
Bitcoin was about $72,400 when the news broke and hit $71,300 at 10:00am ET, its lowest since mid-to-late August, per CoinDesk.

stories.title: Bitcoin funds lose $1.44B in five days
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin funds had net outflows for a fifth straight trading day on Wednesday 11 November, about $300M. Bitcoin now trades well below what the average fund buyer paid, so many fund holders are sitting on losses.
points: Net outflow on 11 Nov was about $299.9M per SoSoValue data reported by Bitcoinist; CoinDesk says about $300M.
BlackRock's IBIT lost about $270M and Grayscale's GBTC $39M, while Morgan Stanley's MSBT took in about $9M, per CoinDesk.
The five-day streak totals about $1.44B, per Bitcoinist.
Glassnode puts the average fund buyer's cost at about $81,500, per CoinDesk.
Ether funds lost about $145M the same day, per CoinDesk.

stories.title: Markets treat a December Fed rate hike as near-certain
stories.summary: Futures markets price a quarter-point rate increase at the 8-9 December Fed meeting as almost certain, and Cleveland Fed President Hammack said on Thursday she favours small, frequent hikes. Higher rates and a stronger dollar tend to pull money away from risky assets like crypto.
points: Markets priced a 94% chance of a quarter-point hike in December, per CoinDesk at 10:55am ET; CME FedWatch put the chance of any hike at 100%, per U.Today.
Hammack said policy needs to become restrictive and that inflation data is moving in the wrong direction, per Reuters via WBOW.
The 10-year Treasury yield was above 5% and the dollar index above 103, per CoinDesk.
Weekly jobless claims rose to 200,000, above the 195,000 forecast, per Reuters via Investing.com.

briefs.title: MSCI confirms Strategy and Metaplanet removals
briefs.summary: Strategy leaves the MSCI USA Index and Metaplanet the Japan Small Cap Index after the 30 November close, per The Block.

briefs.title: Polymarket cuts staff
briefs.summary: The prediction market confirmed a company-wide reduction in force as rival Kalshi pulls ahead in monthly volume, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Crypto firms back challenge to Illinois crypto tax
briefs.summary: a16z, Paradigm, Uniswap and the DeFi Education Fund filed a supporting brief against Illinois's 0.2% digital asset transaction tax, per The Block.

briefs.title: Indian exchange Unocoin keeps logins suspended
briefs.summary: Logins have been suspended since 9 November and the exchange flagged outgoing ETH from a BitGo address; it says over 90% of customer funds are in cold storage, per The Block.

briefs.title: US home sales hit lowest since 2010
briefs.summary: Existing home sales fell 5.5% in October to a 3.75M annual rate, the lowest since August 2010, per the National Association of Realtors.
